common.placeholderBody: This screen arrives in a later step of the build.

common.errorBody: Reload the page. If it keeps happening, your entered scores are still saved on this device.

auth.signInHint: For organizers. Jurors sign in with the personal link their organizer sent them.
auth.magicLinkHint: We'll email you a one-time link — no password needed.
auth.magicLinkSent: Check your email for a sign-in link.
auth.deactivated: Your account was deactivated. Contact the event organizer.
auth.redeemLoadingBody: Hold on, we're signing you in.
auth.redeemInvalidBody: It may have been replaced by a newer one. Ask the organizer for your current link.
auth.redeemInactiveBody: Your juror account isn't active right now. Ask the organizer to reactivate it.
auth.redeemErrorBody: Something went wrong. Ask the organizer to resend your link.

events.title: Events
events.emptyDescription: Create your first event, or copy the setup from one you've run before.
events.createBlankDescription: Starts empty — add themes, criteria and teams afterwards.
events.copyDescription: Copies themes, criteria and weights into a new event. Teams and jurors aren't copied.
events.errorEndsBeforeStart: The end time must be after the start time.
events.errorInvalidDate: Enter valid start and end times.
events.errorPitchMinutesRange: Pitch length must be between 1 and 60 minutes.
events.errorNoSource: Choose an event to copy from.
events.saveError: Couldn't save the event. Try again.
events.statusAutoHint: Follows the start and end dates.
events.confirmLockBody: Jurors won't be able to submit or change scores until you unlock the event.
events.confirmUnlockBody: Jurors will be able to score again. Use this to let a juror fix a mistake.
events.confirmOpenBody: Jurors can start scoring immediately, even if the start date hasn't arrived yet.
events.confirmAutoBody: Scoring will open and close based on the event's start and end dates.
